gdrive.setupDescription: Pick one folder in your Google Drive (a test folder is a good start) or all of My Drive. FolderPilot reads names, dates and short previews to sort files, and only changes files after you approve a plan.
gdrive.name: Name in FolderPilot
gdrive.started: Scan started. Files appear as FolderPilot finds them.
gdrive.privacy: FolderPilot stores file names, folders, details and its analysis — not your files. Disconnecting never touches your Drive.
gdrive.notAdmin: Only owners and admins can connect sources.

space.settingsDescription: Rename this space, change the Drive folder it organizes, or disconnect it.
space.changeFolderNote: Choosing another folder starts the index for this space over. Your audit log is kept.
space.disconnectBody: FolderPilot stops organizing this Drive, forgets its index and gives up its access. Your files in Google Drive stay exactly as they are.
space.needsReconnect: FolderPilot can't reach this Google Drive anymore: {{reason}}
